messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "your medicine comes with directions for properly cleaning your device"
set: ["your medicine comes with directions for properly cleaning your device", "your medicine comes with directions for priming if needed", "measure liquid medicine with supplied measuring device", "always use the new inhaler device provided with your refill", "press the device firmly against your skin", "measure liquid medicine with dosing syringe or medicine dose-measuring device", "talk with your healthcare provider about the benefits of breastfeeding alongside your need for this medicine", "use a medicine dose-measuring device", "always follow your doctor's directions when giving to a child", "call your doctor for instructions", "use the dose counter on your albuterol inhaler device", "measure with marked oral syringe, dosing spoon, or medicine cup that comes with it", "ask your doctor before stopping the medicine", "never share your medicines with others", "check your label for storage instructions", "talk with your doctor about ways to keep your bones healthy"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
